subject: [PATCH v3 2/5] mm: don't PTE-batch a swap-in of a folio with a hardware-poisoned page

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch and expressed surprise at not knowing about folio_test_anon() function.

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a bug in the large-folio batching path of the mm module, where a poisoned page is not properly checked for and mapped. The fix involves skipping batching for anon folios containing a hardware-poisoned page and allowing each page to take its own fault.
